candidate_state: NOT LANDED at audit time: the 4 values live only in the translator draft ru-s16d.json. Pre-landing bytes cannot be bound (ledger-assemble derives target_sha256 from disk and refuses a receipt that does not name them), so target_sha256 below is a PREDICTION for the exact byte form stated in report section 7; the integrator must re-derive it after landing.

target.note: state on disk at audit time (pre-landing: one key, yesterday_at). The predicted LANDED hash is target_sha256 above.

minor.problem: The sidecar grants joiner freedom for date_at only; weekday_at's tone says 'Terse label, no punctuation' and its note gives no joiner freedom. CLDR ru renders weekday:long + hour + minute as a bare space ('понедельник 14:30'), matching the English joiner; the added comma is unsupported by either authority. Meaning is unaffected and a native reads it acceptably, so this is a minor, not a major.
minor.disposition: open — minor; may be deferred in the PR thread

minor.problem: The label starts with a lowercase letter because Intl ru returns weekday:long as 'понедельник' and ConversationDivider paints the composed string verbatim (no capitalize class, no first-letter helper in src/i18n). English is unaffected because English weekday names are capitalised. The translator cannot fix this: the placeholder must be inserted unchanged. Reaches users only via formatDividerLabel -> groupMessages -> trace.stories.tsx today; the live transcript states time per turn via TurnTimestamp.
minor.proposed: No catalogue change. App-side: capitalise the first character of the composed divider label at the render site.
minor.disposition: open — minor, app-side; no catalogue fix exists
